A1.justification: Local commands to read the PDF skill and extract both PDFs remained pending without returning content despite retries. Neither PDF nor its appendices could be inspected, so material completeness and comparability remain unverified. This is an access gap, not evidence of missing document content.

before.justification: No content could be retrieved from v1.pdf to establish whether it reports original empirical results.

after.justification: No content could be retrieved from v2.pdf to establish whether it reports original empirical results.

M1.justification: The method descriptions were unavailable, preventing comparison of algorithms, architectures, objectives, and inference procedures.

E1.justification: The experimental sections and appendices were unavailable, so changes in datasets, tasks, and test scenarios cannot be established.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons could not be inspected to verify baseline membership in corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Evaluation protocols and settings could not be read or matched across versions.

E4.justification: The unavailable experimental and appendix content prevents determining whether ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary analyses changed.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and uncertainty reporting could not be inspected in either version.

E6.justification: Result tables, figures, and passages were unavailable, preventing verification of numerical or qualitative differences under matched conditions.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, equations, and proofs could not be inspected, including any appendix material.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions could not be read to compare the main claims and contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations, mechanism explanations, and limitations were unavailable for comparison.

D1.justification: Implementation details and resource-access statements could not be inspected to distinguish new disclosures from revised settings.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and reference lists could not be read to establish citation or positioning changes.

P1.justification: Without readable document content, the extent of language editing or structural reorganization cannot be assessed.

P2.justification: The PDFs could not be rendered or inspected, so changes to figures, tables, captions, and layout remain unresolved.

improvement.justification: Neither PDF could be inspected because local reading commands returned no content. There is therefore insufficient evidence to identify substantive changes or assess their net effect on overall paper quality.
